jd.position: Software Engineer / AI Code Trainer (Python, Web, Full Stack)

required.quote: Software Engineering Proficiency: Strong core fundamentals in at least one major programming language or web stack (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C++, Go, C#, Rust, PHP).
Debugging & Code Review: Ability to quickly analyze third-party code, catch subtle logical errors, and evaluate efficiency.

gaps: Security auditing of code (the tree has security only as Cerby's business domain)
Evaluating or training AI models (the tree has daily use of AI coding agents and AI-engineer training, not grading model output)

summary.en: Software developer with **{years} years of experience** across the gaming, media, and enterprise sectors, collaborating with major global companies. As an **AI enthusiast**, I work daily with AI coding agents to optimize backend development and accelerate project delivery. I am a rapid learner, highly adaptable to new technology stacks. Having previously **led teams of up to six people** and reviewed every pull request they shipped, I consistently deliver high-quality, well-tested software on time and within budget.
summary.es: Desarrollador de software con **{years} años de experiencia** en videojuegos, medios y empresa, con compañías globales de primer nivel. Como **entusiasta de la IA**, trabajo a diario con agentes de programación con IA para optimizar el backend y acelerar la entrega de proyectos. Aprendo rápido y me adapto a nuevos stacks tecnológicos. Habiendo **liderado equipos de hasta seis personas** y revisado cada pull request que entregaban, entrego software probado y de alta calidad, a tiempo y en presupuesto.

experience.why: Cerby is the Python + web full-stack match (Flask backend, Next.js/TypeScript frontend); Fox Corp shows code review (PR reviews for the whole squad) and debugging; Dow Jones shows test discipline (extensive unit tests per feature) and AI-assisted coding with Claude Code. Inditex (Java microservices, API first) is backend but adds nothing the JD weighs beyond the others, so it is left out. Wizeline's own AI work (coding agents daily, AI-engineer training in Python) matches the AI Code Trainer role.
